title: Read the same selection in JCR-SQL2
prompt:
Edit the provided existing 16:9 AEM slide. Make ONE localized change: add the small two-digit slide number "06" at the TOP LEFT, in the narrow header margin above the existing title. Use dark navy bold condensed sans-serif, approximately 24px at a 1680px-wide slide, aligned to the title's left edge. Keep the number distinct and legible with a small safe margin from the top edge. Number appears exactly once as slide metadata. Do not alter existing numbers inside examples or diagrams.
Preserve every original title, word, code character, diagram, icon, color, grid line, layout, footer, and aspect ratio. Do not paraphrase, correct, expand or add other content. Keep all content within the canvas. Only make a minimal title adjustment if essential to prevent overlap with the new number; never move or shrink the main content panels. This is an image edit, not a redesign. The only new visible text is "06".

input_images.role: Existing slide image: strict edit target. Preserve all content; add only the assigned slide number.
